FULL TEXT:
THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
NOTICE
No.C.0305/2023
In pursuance of “High Court of Gujarat-Designation of Senior
Advocates Rules, 2018”, this High Court has published Notices No.
C.0305/2023/CDSA/01 dated 22/02/2023 and
No.C.0305/2023/CDSA/02 dated 14/03/2023.
In response to above said notification, 29 applications seeking
designation as Senior Advocate have been received by this
Secretariat from the Applicants mentioned in the list annexed
hereto.
The written suggestions/views of other stakeholders as per
Rule 15 of “High Court of Gujarat—Designation of Senior Advocates
Rules, 2018” are invited in respect of the applications for
designation of Senior Advocates. The suggestions/views shall be
submitted by post or through’ registered e-mail ar-
cbranch@gujarat.gov.in (attachment should be in pdf form only) on
or before 19.06.2023. The suggestions/views shall bear the name
and full address of the sender and shall be addressed to the
“Secretary, Committee for Designation of Senior Advocates,
High Court of Gujarat, Ahmedabad”.
Anonymous _petitions/representations/views will not be
entertained. The Suggestions/views submitted beyond the said
stipulated date and time shall not be entertained.
y(A. Raveéndran)
Secretary
Ahmedabad Committee for Designation
